title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
A leading Shipping and Logistics organization is currently expanding and seeking an experienced
**Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)**
, partnering closely with business leaders to drive talent, performance, employee engagement, and people strategies across the organization.

**Overview**

Partner with senior leaders across Singapore and overseas offices to drive people strategies, enhance organizational effectiveness, and support business growth. This role combines strategic HR Business Partnering with leadership in talent management, employee relations, workforce planning, and regional HR operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner closely with business leaders to align HR strategies with business objectives and support organizational growth and transformation.
* Act as a trusted advisor on workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, employee relations, organizational development, and change management initiatives.
* Lead end-to-end recruitment activities for key and critical hires across regional business units.
* Oversee performance management, talent reviews, employee engagement, and leadership development initiatives across multiple countries.
* Support compensation, benefits, payroll governance, and manpower budgeting activities while ensuring compliance with local regulations and company policies.
* Drive HR projects and process improvements to enhance employee experience, operational efficiency, and organizational effectiveness.
* Provide guidance on employee relations matters, disciplinary cases, performance issues, and stakeholder management.
* Analyze HR metrics, workforce trends, and people data to provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management.
* Collaborate with regional stakeholders to ensure consistent implementation of HR policies, processes, and best practices.

**Ideal Candidate**

* 8 – 10 years of progressive HR experience, including significant HR Business Partnering exposure.
* Strong experience partnering with senior stakeholders and business leaders.
* Solid background across talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, organizational development, and regional HR operations.
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable operating in a lean and fast-paced environment with a high degree of autonomy.

title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Senior Human Resources Business Partner**

Frazer Jones is delighted to be partnering with a leading technology organization to appoint a Senior Human Resources Business Partner to join its growing team. We are looking for a commercially minded HR professional to partner closely with senior leaders and drive strategic people initiatives across a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Reporting to the HR lead, you will be a trusted advisor to business leaders, providing strategic and operational HR support across a broad range of people matters. You will work closely with leadership teams to align talent strategies with business objectives while championing organizational effectiveness and leadership capability.

You will partner with stakeholders on workforce planning, talent management, organizational design, performance management, employee relations, succession planning, and change management initiatives. You will also collaborate with regional and global centres of excellence to deliver best-in-class people solutions and drive continuous improvement across HR processes and programs.

**What's on Offer**

This represents an opportunity to join a highly innovative and people-centric organization during an exciting phase of growth and transformation. You will gain exposure to senior leadership, contribute to strategic business initiatives, and play a meaningful role in shaping the employee experience and culture. The successful candidate will play a critical role in shaping the people agenda, enabling business growth, and fostering a high-performance culture.

**Ideal Profile**

The ideal profile comes with a strong track record of partnering with senior stakeholders in complex, high-growth environments and 10 to 15 years of progressive HR Business Partnering experience. You possess excellent commercial acumen, strong influencing skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while balancing strategic priorities with operational execution.

**Location:**
Singapore

**Additional Information:**
Due to an overwhelming volume of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We thank you for your interest and will be in touch regarding future relevant opportunities.
